text:
alex: Hey team — quick ask: can someone sanity-check runbook anchors + a couple shortlinks in /kb/runtime/kv-cache? I found a couple 404s locally. Low priority but would love a quick thumbs if you're free :pray:

maria: I can take a look in ~30m. Which runbook exactly?

alex: /kb/runtime/kv-cache.md and runbooks/kv-cache-operational.md. Specifically anchors under the Troubleshooting -> Prefix cache miss section.

joel: pinging @maria ^ — if you ripgrep for 'prefix-cache-miss' you'll find the references. I ran a quick local scan, here's the output: 

joel: ```
rg "prefix-cache-miss" -n ./content | head
content/kb/runtime/kv-cache.md:142:#prefix-cache-miss
content/runbooks/kv-cache-operational.md:57:#prefix-cache-miss.
```

joel: Notice the trailing dot in the second file — that will break internal anchor linking in the KB.

docs-bot: Automated link-scan report: 2 broken anchors found in /kb/runtime — ticket created #KB-4321 (https://tracker.internal/KB-4321).

samantha: I can open a tiny PR to normalize anchors (remove trailing punctuation and update references). LMK if you want me to add a short redirect for the old shortlink. :+1:

maria: Quick heads up — there are also a couple shortlinks (short.red/kv, short.red/kv-runbook) that currently 302 to S3 and sometimes 403 in staging. I can replace those with canonical paths and add a shortlink redirect in the same PR. Will test in staging.

alex: Awesome. If you make a PR, add @joel for CR and add a one-line changelog so ops knows about the redirect. No rush.

maria: Will do. Expect a PR by EOD. Running a quick grep to find punctuation-in-anchors first: 

maria: ```
# check for trailing punctuation in anchors
rg "href=.*#.*[\.|,|;|)]" -n content | sed -n '1,20p'
```

maria: Found 3 occurrences total; I'll fix them all and update any referencing links.

joel: If preview rendering in staging looks off after the fix ping me and I’ll run a sweep (I can reindex the staging KB).

alex: thanks all — assigning to @maria. :rocket: 

samantha: tiny nit: add a commit message like "docs(kb): normalize anchors, replace shortlinks" so it's easy to trace.

maria: noted. PR will include changelog + shortlink redirect + test notes.

alex: perfect, closing the async loop. :thumbsup:
